**Base trees, a sub-canopy and tree sizes, for forests as the Conquest Reforged team paints them.** A block has one base plant layer and one base tree layer: painting another over it takes its place, so two plants or two species never grow on one block. An object layer can now be a **sub-canopy** layer (Canopy ▸ Sub-canopy in its settings): it is painted beside the base trees instead of in their place, and its objects (hazel, holly, bushes) grow under their canopy, in the air the trees leave, never through a trunk or a crown; the Bushes and Azalea bushes of Packs are sub-canopy layers. The new **Tree sizes** tool (Decor group, and four swatches in the Layers panel) marks where bushes, small, medium or large trees grow: paint the sizes first, then one species over everything, and each spot takes that species' objects of the size marked, a layer's objects being split by height into four sizes. The rest of WorldPainter's layers also come with a `.world` now: caverns, chasms and caves are carved where they were painted, tunnel layers become levels, custom ground cover layers become terrains, and combined layers bring the layers they hold with their terrain and biome; only underground pockets and rivers are left.
